trigger.description: An ee.daemon.context RPC arrives at the UDS daemon before the ANN warm-load slice has shipped; the skeleton dispatch table returns the stub error envelope and tags the response with daemon_ann_warmload_not_yet_implemented so the CLI client knows to fall back to the in-process ee context path.
trigger.invocation: ee.daemon.context RPC sent over the UDS socket (see tests/daemon_uds_rpc_round_trip.rs)
